title: Open to giving referrals at Google
body: I can refer 2–3 students for Summer 2027 SWE internships. Message me with your resume and the role you're targeting.

title: Spotify ML internship referrals
body: Our ML team is hiring interns. If you have recsys or NLP project experience, reach out.

title: Breaking into product management
body: The #1 thing I look for in APM candidates: evidence you've shipped something end-to-end. Side projects count!

title: Datadog is hiring new grads in Boston
body: We're opening new-grad SWE roles on my team next month. Happy to do coffee chats beforehand.

title: Robotics portfolio tips
body: Video of your robot working > photos of your robot. Keep clips under 30 seconds.
